g.title: HR_SCENARIOPARTICIPANT
g.text: Scenario Participant - A Scenario Participant is an individual participating in the scenario. If a new hire, it’s a simulated person without a link to any existing person in the HCM database.
If the participant is not a “Joker”, this field returns the person associated.
Company Relationship of the scenario participant
If the participant is created from an hiring request, this is the Hiring Request linked to the participant.
If the participant is created from a budget pool request, this is the Pool Id requesting.
